name: Analytics and events

requirements.text: Each consented analytics event has an immutable UUID, exact content references, UTC occurrence time, coarse referrer/browser/platform, HMAC visitor hash, and hash-key version.
Analytics never persists raw IP address, full user agent, access code, secret, password hash, or destination URL.
Account and link views support fixed UTC 7, 30, and 90 day windows without historical event backfill.
Views show total clicks, consented unique visitors, zero-filled daily clicks, event totals, and top referrers/browsers/platforms.
Analytics respects owner/resource authorization and telemetry failure never blocks public delivery.

Public rendered surfaces request a 180-day granted/denied tracking choice before rich events or pixels. Show Allow only when the server confirms the privacy URL, analytics hash key, and key version are configured; keep Decline available. Production prunes events after 90 days.
Analytics provides local GeoIP country rollups, live polling, CSV export, and explicitly declared custom events.
Insights and exports share workspace, resource, event, client, country, and UTM filters while omitting visitor hashes.
Country is resolved only from a configured local MaxMind database; absent data remains explicitly unavailable.

externalPrerequisites: ANALYTICS_HASH_KEY and key version in production
PUBLIC_PRIVACY_URL in production to enable the granted-consent path
Local MaxMind database for country dimensions

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each selected window returns zero-filled UTC dates and authorization-scoped totals.
Direct-delivery telemetry failures do not prevent a successful outbound redirect.
Live polling pauses while the browser tab is hidden and never claims websocket delivery.
Public consent pages receive an explicit server-provided grant capability; hide Allow and retain Decline when the privacy URL, hash key, or key version is missing.
The overview, event table, and CSV export use the same validated filters and omit visitor hashes.
Country results come only from the configured local MaxMind database; missing, unreadable, or corrupt data yields no country.

observedBehaviors: The overview uses summary metrics, a time-series chart, and a circular breakdown.
Date and engagement/event controls are visible above the report.
Events are presented in a dense table.
Rows expose event, resource, time, and coarse client-dimension columns.

implementationEvidence.description: The complete isolated Laravel suite passed (271 tests, 11,961 assertions); TrackingConsentTest passed 7 tests (48 assertions), including an explicit false grant capability when the privacy URL exists but hashing keys are incomplete. TypeScript requires the server capability on all three public surfaces.

implementationEvidence.description: On the canonical /dashboard/insights?days=7 route, the page preserved the selected 7-day window in the URL; ArrowRight moved focus and selection from Engagements to Tracked events and updated the tabpanel's aria-labelledby to the selected tab.

The final isolated Laravel suite passed 475 tests and 16,100 assertions with one conditional ClamAV-dependent skip; it includes analytics, API, webhook, notification, catalog, and demo-seeder coverage.
